scope: All legitimate anchored-domain trough-to-return events in the E-rule-revised main cohort; no additional growth threshold

definitions.event_domain: Original first-LMI-anchored near-peak union and intervening bridges; retain original legal interval and state rules
definitions.trough: Last occurrence of minimum processed wind between temporary departure and its next near-peak return; retain every actual subsequent six-hour observation and fluctuation
definitions.event_identity: SID plus chronological anchored return ordinal; no energy-derived recentering
definitions.Resolution: Original final departure to original tropical record endpoint; subsequent below-threshold strengthening is retained

time_composite.sample: Every available actual-track observation, no extrapolation or post-event-survival selection
time_composite.in_rise_flag: trough <= UTC <= return; show separate count of observations still within the rise at each lag
time_composite.pre_change: trough minus -24 h, only when both endpoints observed

phase_summary.rise_domain: [trough,return] endpoints for observed states; legal [trough,return) six-hour intervals for duration
phase_summary.state_mean: Trapezoid integral over the actual complete rise divided by actual rise duration
phase_summary.rate_integral: Trapezoid integration in seconds of the actual diagnosed rate; retain the corresponding rate mean and duration separately
phase_summary.coverage: Every actual six-hour endpoint required for a complete phase mean/integral for that diagnostic; missing endpoints produce missing complete-phase estimate and an explicit support record
phase_summary.endpoint_change: Return minus trough on observed regional means; it is not an asserted closed moving-area budget
phase_summary.raw_Resolution_comparison: Each event rise mean minus the same SID whole-Resolution time-weighted mean on original legal intervals, descriptive across unequal state paths; no paired integral difference across unequal durations
phase_summary.energy_integrals: Only diagnostic rate integrals (e.g. W kg-1 integrated in seconds gives J kg-1) are interpreted as integrated tendencies/conversion/transport; KE/APE state integrals are not reported as supply.

comparable_state_matching.source: p4_p5_sources.py match_intensity rules, explicitly adapted from pre/post to rise/Resolution
comparable_state_matching.eligible_nodes: Actual finite-wind observations at the left endpoint of a legal six-hour interval; rise nodes before return; Resolution nodes in original Res; no future-survival rule
comparable_state_matching.rise_representative: Within each event and wind bin, closest actual wind to bin midpoint; ties earliest UTC
comparable_state_matching.Resolution_representative: Within the same SID and bin, closest actual wind to bin midpoint; ties latest UTC, preserving the existing representative rule
comparable_state_matching.unmatched: Retained in coverage ledger; no other-SID replacement, interpolation, or environment-dependent selection
comparable_state_matching.within_event: Equal weight among jointly valid shared bins, specific to each diagnostic
comparable_state_matching.within_SID: Equal weight among eligible event means, then equal weight across SID
comparable_state_matching.control_reuse: One Resolution representative may serve several events of a SID; all are kept in one SID cluster
comparable_state_matching.full_pair_table: Retain both timestamps, observed wind mismatch, positions, prior six-hour tendency and phase; report state support and descriptive background differences without adding a new causal model
comparable_state_matching.retrospective_scope: Representative points use the recorded wind history and existing chronology tie rules; this is a retrospective state comparison, not a real-time algorithm or causal adjustment.

diagnostics.energy_supporting: Retain all original direct diagnostic terms and pressure/windows; finite selection of panels after full evidence review, no selective table omission
diagnostics.headroom: Use original PI and V units; report Delta H = Delta PI - Delta V with the exact same paired support
diagnostics.environment_geometry: Reuse existing per-variable definitions and source identity; 200-800 km environment, actual 100-300/300-800 km moisture annuli; do not equate old 90% and MWT 80% coverage

statistics.CI: ordinary percentile 95% on fixed observed diagnostic support, cluster resample SID; no redraw to fill failures
statistics.primary_new_rise_comparison: Mean of within-SID rise-minus-Resolution shared-wind-bin differences
statistics.multiplicity: New rise analyses report estimates and uncertainty with explicit diagnostic scope; do not label unadjusted interval exclusion as BH significance. Any additional formal test family must be fixed in a separate recorded amendment before group effects are reviewed.
statistics.first_event_sensitivity: Retain only chronological first legitimate rise event per SID, not first event with favorable/complete results; show original-all-event estimate on same SID support and direct difference
statistics.time_support: n SID and n events at every relative time, metric and level; no complete +24h survival filter

MWT_reuse: Exact UTC/domain/mask/reference/operator/version identity required; missing selected coefficient rows need explicit incremental transforms of original continuous fields. Old departure composites are not relabelled as rises.
stop_conditions: Old/new wind-only cohort and boundaries reproduced and every affected result dependency classified
Every eligible event and unavailable requested observation has a coverage record
All defined direct contrasts and one first-event sensitivity computed with retained uncertainty, regardless of direction
Methods, figures and final claims describe actual estimands and distinguish physical rate integrals from observed endpoint changes
prohibitions: No full three-dimensional transfer or continuity replacement
No remapping whole Res as one weakening event
No new causal model or threshold search
